title: Untangle routing tangles: extract fallback strata, split decision plane, and accelerate regional affinity
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: Over the last 3 years the smart-routing layer accrued several ad-hoc fallback paths, inlined region affinity checks, and a monolithic policy evaluator. This has resulted in high contention (global locks), duplicated telemetry, and difficulty onboarding newer routing strategies (priority queues, staged fallback).

Goal: Reduce tail latency variance and lock contention in the smart router by splitting the decision plane into a light hotpath (request -> route candidate selection) and an async fallback coordinator (event-sourced executor). Extract fallback strata (fast local fallbacks, regional fallbacks, cross-region fallbacks) into a clear contract. Upgrade protobufs and gRPC client libs to remove legacy shims and enable streaming fallback events. Introduce a compact region-affinity bloom filter cache to reduce RPCs to the topology service.

Scope (what we'll change):
- Introduce DecisionFacade API: sync, minimal-alloc hotpath used by request path.
- Implement FallbackCoordinator service: event-sourced, queue-based executor that issues fallback promotions and demotions asynchronously.
- Migrate existing fallback state machine to event model; keep compatibility adapter during rollout.
- Replace global routing mutex with per-shard lease + optimistic reads.
- Add in-memory affinity bloom filters tiered per-region and refresh jittering.
- Upgrade protobufs (v3.12 -> v3.20) and grpc-java (1.35 -> 1.50); sweep generated clients.
- Remove legacy route-policy JSON shims; move canonical policy DSL into repository.

Out of scope: full replacement of the smart-router (large rewrite), Dedicated capacity autoscaler changes, UI console changes except for telemetry surfaces noted below.
acceptance_criteria: 99th-percentile request routing latency on p99-critical paths reduced by >= 25% in canary region
Routing hotpath no longer takes global lock; verified via flamegraphs and contention metrics
FallbackCoordinator handles existing fallback scenarios with <= 2% behavioral delta (measured against regression harness)
Protobuf and gRPC upgrades build in CI for all relevant modules and pass integration tests
Affinity bloom filter reduces topology RPCs by >= 60% under synthetic traffic
Rollout plan documented and can be reverted safely within 30 minutes
tasks: Prototype compact bloom filter (rust module) and bench against topology API
Implement DecisionFacade interface and switch single-route hotpath to use it (canary)
Build FallbackCoordinator with event log and connector to existing state adapter
Upgrade protobufs & grpc-java across modules; fix generation breakages
Add per-shard lease manager and replace global mutex usages
Create regression harness and run nightly compare (tools/regression/fallback-tests)
Prepare rollout runbook and create monitoring dashboards (grafana link below)
Canary rollout in region-us-east-1; monitor for 48h before progressive rollout

2025-11-20 — Miguel Santos: Uploaded design doc draft (confluence). Key decision: event-sourced fallback coordinator preferred to retain deterministic replay for audits.
2025-12-05 — Lina Zhao: Raised concern about protobuf upgrade compatibility with some older Dedicated agent versions; suggested a compatibility shim for 3 months.
2026-01-07 — Miguel Santos: Spike complete for bloom filter; prototype reduces topology calls by ~68% in local benchmarks (see bench logs: https://perf.redwood.ai/bench/affinity-proto-20260107)
2026-01-20 — PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/4921 — DecisionFacade initial implementation. Needs unit tests for optimistic read path.
2026-02-02 — Security review: initial review passed, but requested key rotation check for any code that persists event logs (ticket: SEC-2243)

2026-02-09 — Integration tests: fallback regression harness vs production playback shows 1.7% behavioral delta (within threshold). Noted two edge-case mismatches on throttling semantics — investigating.

2026-02-18 — Miguel Santos: Canary rollout in us-east-1 started at 10:30 UTC. Observed p99 reduction of 28% on routing hotpath after DecisionFacade flip. FallbackCoordinator queue depth stable. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/route-modernization/overview?orgId=1
2026-02-19 — QA: Found intermittent NPE in compatibility adapter when legacy policy JSON contains empty rules array. Added defensive parsing in adapter.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge feature flags behind config: decision_facade=true, fallback_coordinator=false
2) Merge DecisionFacade and enable in canary region (us-east-1) for 5% traffic
3) Run 48h regression + load tests; monitor p50/p95/p99, fallback counters, and topology RPCs
4) Enable FallbackCoordinator in canary at 1% traffic; run synchronous adapter to verify correctness
5) Gradually increase FallbackCoordinator to 25% and then 100% while monitoring SLAs
6) Remove compatibility adapter after 90 days if no regressions observed
